text: And suddenly, not by design but by accident, I made a discovery in physiology.” “Yes?” “You know the red colouring matter of blood; it can be made white—colourless—and remain with all the functions it has now!” Kemp gave a cry of incredulous amazement. The Invisible Man rose and began pacing the little study. “You may well exclaim. I remember that night. It was late at night—in the daytime one was bothered with the gaping, silly students—and I worked then sometimes till dawn.
